title: Brief special meeting authorizes closed session
subtitle: Closed session to cover legal advice, land acquisition, a personal matter and confidential third-party information; no delegations.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a short special meeting on June 23, 2025. The only business was authorizing a closed session to follow immediately afterward, and Council approved it {{vote:m1}}.

The closed session was to consider five items under the Municipal Act, 2001: one solicitor-client privilege matter, two land acquisition matters, one personal matter about an identifiable individual together with a position, plan or instruction for negotiations, and one matter involving third-party information supplied in confidence to the City.

There were no disclosures of pecuniary interest, no delegations and no mayoral business or updates. The meeting adjourned at 3:47 p.m. The minutes report no decisions from the closed session, so residents should not expect public outcomes from this meeting. Any resulting decisions would need to be reported publicly at a later meeting.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to hold a closed session right after the special meeting to consider five matters: legal advice, two land acquisitions, a personal matter with related negotiation instructions, and confidential third-party information.
